topic: Can MVDR beamforming sufficiently compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures?
response: MVDR beamforming can partially compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures, but not entirely, as seen in gain loss differences.
reference_context: Defocused reflector antennas show robustness against feed failures, with MVDR beamforming mitigating some gain loss, as demonstrated in performance comparisons.
